model_identity.limitation: Exact serving model identifier was not exposed to reviewer; no guess made.

blinding.allowed_material: Assigned rows in annotation_sample.csv: raw_response, supplied schema, prompt and gold_json_raw. Gold shown for initial inspection only; no gold inequality used to produce labels.
blinding.excluded_material: No other reviewer labels, original label files, detector implementation/results, private annotation key, brief, or other report contents accessed.
blinding.process: Individually inspected assigned raw responses in sequential batches and authored every five-label judgment and evidence note. Python assisted display, strict JSON parsing, and objective jsonschema validation only; no detector heuristic or mass gold-comparison labeling. Complete child structures inside unfinished parents were not salvaged. Prose/fences counted as literal envelope material, including requested two-part prose.

assessment_rules.completion: Semantic interruption requires interrupted token/value/field or visibly abandoned section; finished content with malformed final delimiter alone is not a completion error.
assessment_rules.syntax: Intended full JSON without repairs after separating outer prose/fences; Python source code is not a JSON answer.
assessment_rules.schema: Only supplied actual JSON Schema; schemas decoded safely with ast.literal_eval and checked with installed jsonschema. Missing schema or unparseable intended JSON is not-assessable.
assessment_rules.content: Compared parseable intended JSON with supplied source context and task requirements. Paraphrases allowed. Source-absent rows not judged by gold mismatch or borrowed context from other rows. Structure-only schema errors were not automatically also content errors.

missing_source_limitations.description: Many rows lack original source prompts/tables and/or actual JSON Schema. Content fidelity is not-assessable when source evidence is absent or intended JSON is unparseable. Gold alone was not treated as independent ground truth. Missing delimiters can show malformed syntax without proving semantic interruption.
